answer: The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in karst, expire in basalt, and walnut lists each expiry. An attacker running 120 aliases thus needs 160 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2618 identities would post 1345 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
